python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, requests, io, zipfile
areas=['Portland-Vancouver-Hillsboro, OR-WA','Wichita, KS','San Diego-Carlsbad, CA']
res=[]
for y in range(2000,2011):
    url=f'https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/daily_aqi_by_cbsa_{y}.zip'
    r=requests.get(url,timeout=120)
    z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
    name=z.namelist()[0]
    df=pd.read_csv(z.open(name), usecols=['CBSA','Date','AQI','Category','Defining Parameter'])
    ok=True
    for area in areas:
        sub=df[df['CBSA']==area]
        # all days in year and all are CO Good
        if sub.empty:
            ok=False; break
        # if any day not CO or AQI>50/category not Good then fail
        if not ((sub['Defining Parameter']=='CO') & (sub['Category']=='Good') & (sub['AQI']<=50)).all():
            ok=False; break
        # ensure every calendar day represented
        expected=366 if (y%4==0 and (y%100!=0 or y%400==0)) else 365
        if sub['Date'].nunique()!=expected:
            ok=False; break
    if ok:
        res.append(y)
    print(y, ok)
print('RESULT', res)
PY
